title: OpenAI Collaborates with Cerebras to Launch Ultrafast Mode, GPT-5.6Sol Speeds Up by 14 Times
excerpt: On August 13, OpenAI launched a new "Ultrafast" (super fast) mode, significantly improving the processing efficiency of its latest flagship large model, GPT-5.6
content_html:
On August 13, OpenAI launched a new "Ultrafast" (super fast) mode, significantly improving the processing efficiency of its latest flagship large model, GPT-5.6Sol. Official data shows that, while maintaining the original high level of intelligence and output quality, the Ultrafast mode runs up to 14 times faster than the standard processing mode, generating up to 750 output tokens per second.

This feature was jointly developed by OpenAI and chip manufacturer Cerebras, currently in preview phase, and is initially available to selected enterprise customers. It will gradually expand its coverage as computing power increases.

Traditional large model applications have long been constrained by the trade-off between "model capability" and "response speed," often forcing real-time scenarios to use smaller parameter models. The implementation of the Ultrafast mode breaks this dilemma, enabling GPT-5.6Sol to be seamlessly deployed in complex workflows such as event response, customer service, financial market analysis, and e-commerce, which are extremely sensitive to latency.

Compared to the fast mode of its competitor Anthropic's Claude, OpenAI demonstrates stronger advantages in output throughput and execution efficiency. This technological breakthrough marks the acceleration of cutting-edge large models from "high-latency offline inference" toward "high-throughput real-time interaction," and will reshape the deployment form and productivity standards of enterprise-level AI in the future.

content_html_zh:
8月13日，OpenAI推出全新“Ultrafast”（超快）模式，显着提升其最新旗舰大模型GPT-5.6Sol的处理效率。 官方数据显示，在保持原有高水平智能和输出质量的同时，Ultrafast模式的运行速度比标准处理模式快达14倍，每秒生成高达750个输出令牌。

该功能由OpenAI和芯片制造商Cerebras联合开发，目前处于预览阶段，初步向选定的企业客户提供。 随着算力的增强，其覆盖范围将逐步扩大。

传统的大模型应用长期以来一直受到“模型能力”和“响应速度”之间权衡的限制，往往迫使实时场景不得不使用较小参数的模型。 Ultrafast模式的实现打破了这一困境，使GPT-5.6Sol能够无缝部署在事件响应、客户服务、金融市场分析、电子商务等对延迟极为敏感的复杂工作流程中。

相比竞争对手Anthropic的Claude的快速模式，OpenAI在输出吞吐量和执行效率方面表现出更强的优势。 这一技术突破标志着前沿大模型从“高延时离线推理”向“高通量实时交互”加速，将重塑未来企业级人工智能的部署形态和生产力标准。
